title: PTA Details
intro:
The PTA (Parent Teacher Association) is a registered charity that brings together parents, teachers, and the wider school community. Every parent and carer of a child at Aldryngton Primary School is automatically a member of the PTA — there's no need to sign up.

We are run entirely by parent volunteers and are committed to enriching the educational experience of every child at the school. Whether you can give five minutes or five hours, there's always a way to contribute.
whatWeDo: We raise funds to provide school equipment, educational resources, and enriching experiences that go beyond the standard budget. We strengthen the home-school connection by creating opportunities for parents and teachers to work together. We bring together staff, parents, pupils, and the wider community through fun, inclusive events throughout the year.
getInvolved:
1. Help at events — before, during, or after. Every pair of hands makes a difference.
2. Attend meetings and the AGM to share and suggest fundraising ideas.
3. Support events through your attendance and enthusiasm — bring the family along!
4. Volunteer as a Class Rep or Committee member to take on a more active role.
5. Share any relevant skills or contacts that could help with events or fundraising.
6. Suggest how funds should be spent to benefit the children and the school.
7. Make financial donations — by cash, cheque, or online — every contribution counts.
